This caused them to have to go into the forties for their fourth man—Stan Goold, who, by the way, is performing well this season. Thus handicapped, they were beaten by the C team, but they were worthy runners-up.

To both our new Club mates we give a hearty welcome and trust they will spend many happy days with the " Bels." Stan Goold is signing on again after a year's lapse, and Bob Readman has a ccuple of likely members.

A Club Handicap was held in conjunction, and once again young Mac managed to pull it off, with Doub (walking again) 2nd and Stan Goold 3rd. In January Surrey A.C. came to Wimbledon with a strong team and just managed to beat us by one point, the score being 85 point to 86.
